shape.question: Which views should anaxi watch ship first so a team can triage the design at a glance, and read any item or the whole design at the depth they need, without scrolling forever?
shape.approach: anaxi watch: a read-only local reader of linked pages (overview → topic → item, depth control, outline, parts inline, superseded banner, next/previous in uses: order) with a 2D depth-bar map that zooms by topic; all from one ViewModel; a city view possible later over the same layout

rejected.why: labels collide at 7 items (2/7 hidden), a third at 40; memorable but not readable; a later optional view
17/40 columns hidden and no readable labels at 40 items flat; depth-as-height duplicates the bar
the example's @recurring alone is 439 words at D4; a project reads as pages with a depth control, and one document only for export

rejected.approach: Flat maps of the whole project
rejected.why: no picture labels 150 items on one screen; the top zoom must be topics

decisions.text: Reader first: anaxi watch ships the docs as linked pages (overview → topic → item), each item one page with a depth control, an outline, parts inline, uses/used-by, nudges and the gate; 'next' walks the design in uses: order. Never one endless scroll.

The 2D graph with depth bars is the default map, and it zooms by topic: the project level shows topics (counts and worst status), a topic shows its items. Readable at 7, 40 and 150 items by topic (scale test, 20 seeds).

No city in v1: it is the most memorable picture, but its labels already collide at the example's 7 items (2 of 7 hidden: @scheduler and Upgrade policy in the render) and a third at 40; by topic it holds to ~11 items. Keep it as a later, optional view over the same layout.

No 3D layer stack: @recurring is already hidden behind @multi-calendar at 7 items, and at 40 flat it hides 17 of 40 columns with no label readable; depth is already a length in the 2D bar, so height adds nothing.

Levels come from headings AND from paragraph lead-ins named after the levels (Why, What, Shape, Contract, Build), split mid-paragraph: headings alone give the depth control nothing on 6 of 8 example items.
Readability measured on bounding-box geometry, not pixels or people; a rotatable 3D view could recover some occlusion at the cost of interaction.
The glance matrix is a judgment from the renders, not a user test.

questions.text: Should the checker emit blocks (section and lead-in levels, line ranges) in the JSON, so the reader never re-parses markdown?
A topic above ~25 items stops fitting the 2D map too (the curve fades past 150 items): split it by folder or sub-topic, or fall back to the overview list?
Topic for an item without about: — its folder, or 'unsorted'?
Does the live reload need per-file granularity (SSE with the changed paths) or is a full model refresh fast enough (~0.07 s)?

checks.name: deeper never shows less: words visible at D0 ≤ D1 ≤ … ≤ D4, for every item
no text lost: splitting at lead-ins keeps every word (D4 + canvas + history = all)
lead-ins give the depth control something to filter on most items
synthetic projects: blocked exactly when a used item is short of its target
extreme: one item is readable in every picture
the ranking isn't luck: across 20 seeds at 40 items by topic, 2D reads at least as many items as 3D and the city
